tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Free. Plain text, up to 2,000 characters; code, markup and anything that looks like a key are removed.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "whale_trades" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Free. Every pump.fun buy and sell of $2,500 or more (min_usd from $1,000) in the last hour, oldest first, read from the chain as trades land: each with the wall…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "send_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (private key, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_coin" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
